disposition_policy.internal_target: The call site and checked-in registry prove one or more repository targets.
disposition_policy.external_optional_dependency: The call site imports a package outside src/ and execution, with an explicit optional/runtime boundary.
disposition_policy.runtime_registry: A checked-in registry maps a runtime key to a target pattern; the registry, not source equality, is the authority.
disposition_policy.unresolved: Available source evidence does not prove an exact target; no guess is admitted.
